'''Gareth Jarn''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who was employed by [[Galactic Solutions Industries]] as a [[Quartermaster/Legends|requisitions officer]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. Stationed on the [[Desert/Legends|desert]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], he sold company wares to individuals assisting GSI on their missions in [[Anchorhead/Legends|Anchorhead]].<ref name="TOR" />
